ui.game-complete-msg: Your family's stewardship spans generations. The miombo endures.

evt.title: Events
evt.drought.title: Drought Strikes
evt.drought.body: The rains have failed. Wells are drying up. Crops wither and cattle grow thin. Those who prepared stores will survive — others must make hard choices.
evt.elephant-raid.title: Elephant Crop Raid
evt.elephant-raid.body: A herd of elephants pushed through during the night, trampling and eating crops. A chilli fence around your fields could deter them.
evt.lion-attack.title: Lion Sighted Near Cattle
evt.lion-attack.body: Lions have been seen prowling near the settlement. Cattle left in the open at night are vulnerable. A night kraal would protect them.
evt.tipping-point.title: Land Beyond Recovery
evt.tipping-point.body: The grazing land has crossed a tipping point. Soil is exposed and eroding. Without decades of rest, this damage may be permanent.
evt.woodland-recovery.title: Woodland Flourishing
evt.woodland-recovery.body: The miombo woodland is thriving! Birds and wildlife are returning. The community's restraint in harvesting timber is paying off.
evt.trust-milestone.title: Community United
evt.trust-milestone.body: Trust between families is strong. People attend meetings, share resources, and watch over the commons together. Collective action is working.
evt.neighbor-conflict.title: Neighbor Dispute
evt.neighbor-conflict.body: Some families are ignoring community rules. Tensions are rising. Graduated sanctions — a warning first, then fines — may restore order.
evt.market-opportunity.title: Market Boom
evt.market-opportunity.body: Traders report rising demand for local goods. Prices are climbing. This could be a good time to sell surplus grain or charcoal.
sum.chapter-narrative: Twelve years have passed. The elders have grown old and a new generation takes up the hoe and the herding stick. Will they remember the lessons learned?
sum.chapter-pressure: The population has grown. More families compete for the same land. Newcomers bring cattle, and trust must be rebuilt.
